_comment: Route manifest for the UI health sweep. Each entry is visited by scripts/ui-health/sweep.ts. `auth` selects which session loads it (public = no login). `{placeholders}` are substituted from fixtures the sweep creates at runtime (see sweep.ts → buildFixtures), so this file never hardcodes DB UUIDs. When you add a new page.tsx under web/src/app, add it here too — the ui-health-sweep skill checks for drift on every run.

fixtures._comment: Documents which placeholders the sweep resolves. Update buildFixtures() in sweep.ts if you add a new one.
fixtures.artistProfileId: A published artist profile owned by the primary artist fixture
fixtures.otherProfileId: A second artist's published profile (for endorse flow — you cannot endorse yourself)
fixtures.collectionId: A collection under the primary artist profile
fixtures.festivalId: An organiser festival with a form, status=open
fixtures.applyFestivalId: A festival the primary artist can apply to (status=open, has form)

skipped.reason: needs a one-time email token in the URL — not a steady-state page
needs a one-time reset token in the URL — not a steady-state page
